results.title: GNU text utilities
results.excerpt: If you have the Slackware Linux distribution, you have the file /usr/lib/ispell/ispell.words, which is a sorted, 38,400 word dictionary. Filenames like this are good examples for sort and uniq.

results.title: Ispell - GNU Project
results.excerpt: Ispell is a fast screen-oriented spelling checker that shows you your errors in the context of the original file.

results.title: sort invocation (GNU Coreutils)
results.excerpt: The sort command sorts, merges, or compares all the lines from the given files, or standard input if none are given.
